services.desc: MUSA will be open during all school holidays for day camps throughout the school year. Camp will start at 8:30 A.M. and run until 2:00 P.M. though you can pick up your children as late as 6:00 P.M. (With an additional $15). Please let us know if you need earlier drop off, or late pick up. Campers will participate in martial arts training, games, and trips to the park. Toys will also be provided by Mudpuddles to keep the good times going. At MUSA Martial Arts, we want every child to have a blast training with us.
